notes.title: Introducing Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken - coming this year!
notes.content:
Have you been missing your time in the Sidereal Plexus Universe?  Have you been lucid dreaming again and need to wake up from the nightmares?  Well, do we have some great news for you!  

Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken takes you back into your dreams on an all-new point and click adventure from scriptwelder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35974395/7da9c4946527684cb06907243524b56a7244d509.gif

Take on the role of Amy, as you solve puzzles, gain skills while awake, and battle dream monsters to find out what happened to your dead brother.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35974395/3621f3394d111a89d38c075a516cb79e0a8c997a.gif

Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken is a standalone entry into the cult classic Deep Sleep series coming later in 2024!  Wishlist now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868360/Deep_Sleep_Labyrinth_of_the_Forsaken/

notes.title: Updates + Deep Sleep Trilogy
notes.content:
1.2.1 summary
 Now when you complete one of the games, its title will be highlighted in the game selection menu.
 Bug preventing some players from getting the "Complete all games" achievement has been fixed!
 Minor bugs fixes

Deep Sleep Trilogy + BUNDLE
If you liked Don't Escape Trilogy and have the courage to face a bit more frightening challenge, you should definitely try Deep Sleep Trilogy that we've just released on Steam!

You can also grab the Scriptwelder Collection bundle and enjoy all the games I've made with a discount!
